c3c920ae60fd.en:
| Ability | Description |
|------|------|
| **Multi-format output** | `html` `md` `pdf` and plugin extensible `docx`/`epub` (PDF generated by Chromium) |
| **Multilingual output** | `zh`/`en`, translation based on `.translations.json` cache, missing fallback AI (provider `auto`) |
| **File Snooping** | Based on `watchdog` snooping source files, `debounce` defaults to 1.5s, change to sync |
| **Templates/themes** | Built-in styles such as `bwx`, `modern`, etc.; themes under the Typora theme directory (`~/.config/Typora/themes/`) can be directly selected (`typora-bloom-mist`, `typora-night`, `typora-claude-like`, etc.), automatically compatible with background, dark/light and code blocks (`md-sync template`/`md-sync plugin`) |
| **Translation cache** | `strategy: mapping` + `mapping_file`, translations only update the cache dictionary, do not directly exit the file, and then access it when rendering |
| **Desktop GUI (Qt native)** | PySide6 native interface, calling the core pipeline directly, continuously listening for synchronization, zero HTTP servers |
| **Standard document (gongwen)** | Built-in document plugin: Write Markdown by template and export redhead document `docx`/`pdf` (redhead, layout, page number automatic layout) in accordance with GB/T 9704-2012 with one click |
